notes: SR81 Graham and Green (UK), Magento 2, direct HTTP fetch throughout, no blocks. Sale/Clearance judgment: URL slug is /sale, but the site's OWN nav mega-menu title, breadcrumb, and <h1> for this entire section all read 'Last Chance' (page <title>: 'Last Chance | Sale | Graham and Green'), not a generic 'Sale' label - 'Last Chance' is an explicit target term in the Clearance brief, and there is no seasonal/campaign framing (no Black Friday/percent-off-campaign copy) on the page - so this was classified as Clearance, not a temporary promo, with no ambiguity flag needed. The nav exposes a genuine 'Sale by Category' sub-structure (11 department links) under the same 'Last Chance' parent, so it was captured as a parent + children per the brief's grouping-row rule. Cross-check: the 11 department listings sum to exactly 464, matching the parent /sale total of 464 exactly - strong confirmation both counts are accurate and the departments are an exact, non-overlapping partition. All counts via exhaustion method (unique product-price tile IDs deduped across all pages using the rendered toolbar page count, plus one page fetched past the end to confirm zero tiles). Also checked for a separate physical 'Warehouse Outlet' nav link (https://www.grahamandgreen.co.uk/info/stores/warehouse-outlet) - this is a store-locator/info page, not an online PLP, so excluded.
